tools.name: list_projects
tools.description:
List every assessed decentralised AI project with its dual scores, grades and
    assessment level. Optional filters: category (compute|data|inference|storage|
    agent|platform|other) and status (e.g. active). Returns summaries only; call
    get_project_assessment for the full record. `_rule` sta

tools.name: get_project_assessment
tools.description:
One project's assessment: dual scores + breakdowns, integrity level, verdict
    counts and every checked claim or finding in brief, plus review_url to cite and the
    attestation envelope. full=true returns the whole signed record instead (adds data
    sources and the primary-data snapshot; over

tools.name: get_freedom_breakdown
tools.description:
The 6-dimension Freedom score for a project (infrastructure, governance, token
    distribution, censorship resistance, data sovereignty, open source), each with
    score/max and the evidence behind it, plus grade and total /100.

tools.name: get_returns_breakdown
tools.description:
The 5-dimension Returns score for a project (token utility, value accrual, supply
    dynamics, revenue sustainability, liquidity & access), each with score/max and
    evidence, plus grade and total /100.

tools.name: get_integrity_verdicts
tools.description:
Every claim we checked for a project against independent data: the reconciliations
    (reported figure vs our independent value, method, verdict, evidence link), metric
    flags, and emission honesty. Carries the verdict vocabulary, assessment levels and
    `_rule` verbatim so a caller reports 'n

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description:
Compare several projects on one axis ('freedom' or 'returns'), aligned per
    dimension so an agent can rank them like-for-like. Returns each project's per-
    dimension score/max, total, grade and assessment level.

tools.name: get_agent_trust_snapshot
tools.description:
The latest OYM agent-trust index summary (ERC-8004 agent identity, reputation and
    x402 settlement reconciliation): observations with a methodology version and scope
    notes, never verdicts. Carries `data_as_of` — this data refreshes only periodically.
